title: 2007 AMC 12A Problem 4
statement: Kate rode her bicycle for \(30\) minutes at a speed of \(16\) mph, then walked for \(90\) minutes at a speed of \(4\) mph. What was her overall average speed in miles per hour?

solutions.text:
Kate rode for \(\tfrac12\) hour at \(16\) mph, covering \(8\) miles.

She walked for \(\tfrac32\) hours at \(4\) mph, covering \(6\) miles.

She covered \(14\) miles in \(2\) hours, so her average speed was \(7\) mph.

Thus, the correct answer is A.
hints: Average speed is total distance divided by total time, not the average of the two speeds
She rides \(8\) miles and walks \(6\) miles over a total of \(2\) hours
